newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan minister seeks 4 trln yen extra budget - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan minister seeks 4 trln yen extra budget - Jiji.

text.p: Japan's government needs to craft a supplementary budget totalling some four trillion yen this fiscal year ending March 1997 in order to cope with a possible economic slowdown, Construction Minister Eiichi Nakao was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Tuesday.

"Given the current economic climate, there are worries that the economy may lose momentum in the latter half of the year. We need to ensure sufficient public works projects, and it would be appropriate (to set the amount) at around four trillion yen," he told a news conference.
